known_facts_book1: A niece of the late King Evoldo who lives in the royal palace of Ev and is the nearest thing Ev has to a ruler, though she does not truly rule.
Owns thirty interchangeable heads, one for each day of the month, kept in velvet-lined cupboards in her cabinet.
Wears only one head at a time on her single neck, recognizable to her subjects by the blood-red ruby key on her wrist that unlocks the cupboards.
Lives in a sitting-room panelled floor to ceiling with mirrors so she can admire whichever head she wears.
While wearing her fiery-tempered head No. 17 she demands Dorothy's head for her collection, offering No. 26 in exchange.
Locks Dorothy in the North Tower and orders Billina to the chicken-house when Dorothy refuses.
Is compelled by Ozma to free Dorothy, and gladly gives up her duties, staying home rather than facing the Nome King's heat.
Is permitted by the restored Queen to keep her rooms and cabinet of heads for life.

known_relations_book1.Dorothy: Her prisoner, whose head she covets and whom she locks in the tower.
known_relations_book1.Ozma: The Ruler of Oz who forces her to release Dorothy.
known_relations_book1.Queen of Ev: Her aunt by marriage, restored at the end and letting her keep her heads.
known_relations_book1.Evoldo: Her late uncle, the drowned King of Ev.

known_facts_book1: The wife of the late King Evoldo and mother of ten children — five boys and five girls.
Was sold with her children to the Nome King by her husband and transformed into a purple footstool ornament.
Is the first ornament Billina disenchants, restored as a tall, slender, beautifully robed lady.
Weeps for her children until Billina restores all ten, then embraces each of the nine older ones and her rescued youngest Evring.
Reminds Billina that the missing green ornament she seeks is the grasshopper — Ozma.
Returns to the palace of Ev, crowns her eldest son Evardo the new King, and rewards Billina with a pearl-and-sapphire necklace.

known_relations_book1.Nome King: Her captor, who bought her as a slave and made her an ornament.
known_relations_book1.Evoldo: Her husband, the King of Ev who sold her and their children.
known_relations_book1.Billina: The hen who disenchants her first of all the ornaments.
known_relations_book1.Evardo: Her eldest son, whom she crowns King of Ev.
known_relations_book1.Evring: Her youngest son, rescued by Dorothy.
known_relations_book1.Ozma: The Ruler of Oz who led the expedition to free her.

known_facts_book1: The eldest son of the Queen of Ev, fifteen years old, disenchanted by Billina from a purple ornament.
A grave and quiet youth who inherits his father's throne as King Evardo Fifteenth.
Crowned by his mother on a balcony before the people, with fifteen silver buckles on his jacket, as the fifteenth Evardo to rule Ev.
Promptly goes off to look for cake in the royal pantry after his coronation.
Gives Billina a pearl-and-sapphire necklace and promises Ozma his lasting gratitude and service.

known_relations_book1.Queen of Ev: His mother, who crowns him King.
known_relations_book1.Evring: His younger brother, the little Prince Dorothy rescued.
known_relations_book1.Billina: The hen he rewards with a necklace for freeing his family.
known_relations_book1.Ozma: The Ruler of Oz to whom he pledges gratitude.

known_facts_book1: A princess of Ev, one of the five daughters of the Queen of Ev.
Was transformed by the Nome King into a purple ornament and held in his palace.
Is the first of the children Billina disenchants, appearing as a sweet-faced girl with golden hair falling over her shoulders.
Is embraced and kissed by her mother, who cries 'Evanna! my own Evanna!'
Restored to her proper form and returned to the palace of Ev with the rest of her family.

known_relations_book1.Queen of Ev: Her mother, who embraces her first of the restored children.
known_relations_book1.Billina: The hen who disenchants her from a purple ornament.
known_relations_book1.Evardo: Her eldest brother, who becomes King of Ev.
known_relations_book1.Evring: Her youngest brother, rescued by Dorothy.

known_facts_book1: The youngest son of the Queen of Ev, transformed by the Nome King into a purple kitten.
Is the one royal Dorothy restores, appearing as a fair-haired boy when she touches the kitten and says 'Ev'.
Announces proudly 'I am a Prince of Ev, and my name is Evring.'
Shy of the Scarecrow at first, but becomes fond of Dorothy and rides with her on the Sawhorse.
Unknowingly pockets the green tin pig-whistle that is the transformed Tin Woodman, which is why the Woodman cannot be found.
Cries for his whistle when Billina uses it to restore the Tin Woodman.

known_relations_book1.Dorothy: The girl who restores him from a purple kitten; his rescuer and friend.
known_relations_book1.Queen of Ev: His mother, who takes him in her lap as her youngest born.
known_relations_book1.Evardo: His elder brother, who becomes King of Ev.
known_relations_book1.Tin Woodman: Whose whistle-form Evring carries in his pocket, hiding him from the search.
